atoms.title: Surveillance systems (CCTV, monitoring)
atoms.objective: Describe the components and layout of physical surveillance systems, explain the security differences between active and passive monitoring, and analyze vulnerabilities in surveillance networks to recommend mitigations.

atoms.title: Security guards and layered defense-in-depth
atoms.objective: Explain how security guards function as an active personnel control and how combining multiple control categories creates a defense-in-depth posture that raises the cost of physical attacks on a facility.

atoms.title: Environmental controls (HVAC, fire suppression, power)
atoms.objective: Explain how HVAC, fire suppression, and power systems protect physical infrastructure and describe the alert thresholds that define safe operating ranges.
